observability.title: Observability
observability.description: Configure an external Prometheus scrape URL and OTLP Collector. No monitoring or trace backend is bundled.
observability.loadError: Settings could not be loaded. Try again.
observability.saveError: Settings could not be saved. Check permissions or version conflicts.
observability.metricsHelp: An external Prometheus instance can scrape the service /metrics endpoint.
observability.metricsEndpointHelp: Enter the full HTTP(S) URL reachable by the external collector.
observability.metricsEndpointError: Enter a valid HTTP(S) scrape URL before enabling metrics.
observability.tracingHelp: Send sampled request traces to an external OTLP Collector.
observability.tracingEndpointError: Enter a valid HTTP(S) Collector URL before enabling tracing.
observability.apiKeyHelp: Leave blank to keep the stored redacted credential.
observability.restartHelp: Restart the service after saving to load the collector configuration. Changes, history, and rollbacks are audited.
